data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the Windows computer running the client.
data_description.port: The port the client is listening on (default: 8765).

credentials.title: Enter API Key
credentials.description:
Enter the API key generated by the client.

Client: **{host}:{port}**

Find the key via:
- System tray icon → "Show connection info"
- Or via command line: `ha-shutdown-client.exe --show-password`

zeroconf_confirm.title: Windows Client Found
zeroconf_confirm.description:
Home Assistant has found the following client:

**{name}** ({host}:{port})

Click Confirm to enter the API key.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew API Key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for **{host}** has become invalid. Please enter a new key.

data_description.delay: Number of seconds to wait before shutting down.
data_description.shutdown_type: Choose the desired action: shutdown, restart, or logoff.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Check hostname/IP and port.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key. Check the key on the Windows computer.
error.no_devices_found: No clients found. Try manual entry.
